investment_strategy: Core-and-satellite A.I. leaders with risk-aware sizing. Anchor in high-quality, lower-volatility platform (MSFT) with proven enterprise A.I. monetization; add fast-momentum ad/search A.I. platform (GOOGL) for upside; include a smaller satellite in A.I. infrastructure leader (NVDA) to capture secular GPU demand. With VIX near 20 and 10Y at ~4.23%, lean defensive within tech, emphasize cash-rich franchises, and cap high-beta exposure. No reinvestment planned; monitor earnings, capex cadence, and regulatory headlines; rebalance quarterly or if weights drift >5%.
